poise.description: On hit, gain a Potency-based chance to deal critical damage, reducing the Count by 1 if successful. At the end of the turn, reduce the Count by 1. Critical hits deal 1.2x damage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Resource used by certain skills for additional effects. Its Count can go up to 20. Count lowers by 1 at the end of each turn.

load.name: Load
load.description:
- Max Value: 6
- Attack Skills that consumed Charge Count deal +2.5% more damage for every value on self (max 15%)
- If the affected unit is a W Corp. employee, deal +5% more damage for every value instead (max 30%)
- Turn End: this effect expires

red_eyes.name: Red Eyes
red_eyes.description:
- Base Skill Coin effects inflict +1 more Bleed
- Max Value: 20
- Unique Charge (fixed Potency)
- Resource used by certain Skills for additional effects
- Enhances the buff based on Value
· Stage 1 (1~7): Red Eyes
· Stage 2 (8~15): Red Eyes - Alert
· Stage 3 (16~20): Red Eyes - Devouring
- The amount of additional Bleed inflicted by the first line of this buff is equal to the buff enhancement Stage (max 3)

penitence.name: Penitence
penitence.description:
- Heal 2 SP On Hit with Base Skill Coins that gain Penitence
- Max Value: 20
- Unique Charge (fixed Potency)
- Turn Start: gain (Penitence)% of max HP as Shield
- Resource used by certain Skills for additional effects
- Enhances the buff based on Value
· Stage 1 (1~7): Penitence
· Stage 2 (8~15): Penitence - Periphery
· Stage 3 (16~20): Penitence - Confession
- The amount of SP healed by the first line of this buff is based on the enhancement Stage (enhancement Stage x 2)

e.g.o_resource_amp.name: E.G.O Resource Amp
e.g.o_resource_amp.description: Increases the amount of E.G.O resources earned from skills by the effect's Count for one turn.

fanatic.name: Fanatic
fanatic.description: Raise Skill Final Power by the effect's Count against targets that have Nails for the turn. (Applies to clashes as well)

appetite.name: Appetite
appetite.description: Increases the healing provided by the Passive [Rustle Up]. Spent when the Passive activates.

defensive_stance.name: Defensive Stance
defensive_stance.description:
- Max Value: 2
- This effect does not compound in Potency; stacking it only extends its duration.
- Reduced by 1 at Turn End
- When a unit gains this effect, gain the following effects next turn:
· Fix this unit's Speed to its minimum value
· Gain 5 Defense Level Up
· Each of this unit's Slots gain +(10 / this unit's # of Slots) Aggro
· When chaining Skills, this unit can draw enemies' attack toward this unit regardless of Speed (Focused Encounters only)
· Upon Clash Win, trigger Tremor Burst
· Cannot be Staggered by damage

charge_barrier.name: Charge Barrier
charge_barrier.description:
- Gain (Charge Barrier # x 3) Shield.
- Lose 1 Charge Barrier after losing (Charge Barrier # x 3) Shield.
- (If the unit is a W Corp. employee, ALL Charge Barrier effects activate at (Charge Barrier # x 5) instead of at (Charge Barrier # x 3))
- Turn end: Gain a Charge Count for each Charge Barrier #, and Charge Barrier and Shield gained from Charge Barrier expire completely next turn

unjust_enrichment.name: Unjust Enrichment
unjust_enrichment.description:
- Gained on Heads Hit against targets that have Bleed (Max 4)
- When 'Bullets are Pricey' Passive activates, consume all Unjust Enrichment stack to deal bonus damage

assist_attack.name: Assist Attack
assist_attack.description:
- If unit A applies this effect to unit B: Unit B follows up with an Unopposed Attack with its Skill 1 against the same enemy unit A attacked with its Skill. Activates at unit A's Attack End.
- The Skill used as an Assist Attack does not affect Unit B's upcoming Skills list.

heated_gas_harpoon.name: Heated Gas Harpoon
heated_gas_harpoon.description: For 1 turn, inflict 1 Burn with Heads Hit

overheated_gas_harpoon.name: Overheated Gas Harpoon
overheated_gas_harpoon.description: For 1 turn, inflict 1 Burn On Hit

sword_of_the_homeland_-_rending.name: Sword of the Homeland - Rending
sword_of_the_homeland_-_rending.description: Skill 1 gains Final Power by the effect's Count for this turn

sword_of_the_homeland_-_penetrating.name: Sword of the Homeland - Penetrating
sword_of_the_homeland_-_penetrating.description: Skill 2 gains Final Power by the effect's Count for this turn

swordplay_of_the_homeland.name: Swordplay of the Homeland
swordplay_of_the_homeland.description:
- When at 5+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 1 and Skill 2 gain Coin Power +(3/# of Coins, minimum 1) and deal +(30/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit
- When at 7+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 3 deals +(30/# of Coins)% more damage and deals +(50/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit

remembrance.name: Remembrance
remembrance.description:
- When at 5+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 1 and Skill 2 gain Coin Power +(3/# of Coins, minimum 1) and deal +(30/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit
- When at 7+ Poise, upon Skill use, Skill 3 deals +(30/# of Coins)% more damage and deals +(50/# of Coins)% damage on Critical Hit

borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
borrowed_time.description:
Turn End at 2+ Count:
- Gain (Borrowed Time Count - 1) Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile next turn
- If this unit is set to gain more Bind than Haste next turn, the Borrowed Time effect expires at the next Turn Start, and this unit gets Staggered
Turn End: At 1 Count, gain 2(Borrowed Time Stack - 1) Bind next turn
Turn End: Gain 1 Stack, lose 1 Count

erudition.name: Erudition
erudition.description:
- Max Value: 6
- When Discarding a Skill, gain (Erudition x 1.5)% of this unit's max HP as Shield (once per turn)
- If this unit Discards a Skill at 2+ Insight, gain 1 Clash Power (once per turn)
- Reduced by 1 when taking HP damage after getting hit by an enemy's Attack Skill
- Expires when Staggered

tremor_-_clockwinding.name: Tremor - Clockwinding
tremor_-_clockwinding.description:
- Max Speed +2
- Consume Tremor Count on self to inflict 1 more Tremor Potency or Count when inflicting them with this unit's Skill or Coin Effects
- When Hit by Skills that trigger Tremor Burst, raise the Stagger Threshold by the effect's Potency
- Turn End:reduce the Count by 1
(Interacts the same way as normal Tremor does to effects that raises or reduces Tremor Potency/Count)

blood-tinged_scissorblades.name: Blood-tinged Scissorblades
blood-tinged_scissorblades.description:
- Max Value: 10
- Stage 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades
- At 10+ Blood-tinged Scissorblades, converts to Blood-tinged Scissorblades II.
- At 20+ Blood-tinged Scissorblades, converts to Blood-tinged Scissorblades III.
- Reverts to previous stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- Blood-tinged Scissorblades does not drop below 1.
- At Blood-tinged Scissorblades II, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Down based on the Stack (1/5 Stack)
- At Blood-tinged Scissorblades III, gain 1 Offense Level Up on the Stack (1/5 Stack)

gaze_of_contempt.name: Gaze of Contempt
gaze_of_contempt.description:
- Max Value: 7
- Deal +7% more damage for every Gaze of Contempt
- Turn End: this effect expires
- Turn End: At 7 Gaze of Contempt value, convert it to Contempt of the Gaze next turn instead of expiring

coffin.name: Coffin
coffin.description:
- Max Value: 10
- At Turn End:
- Gain 2 Damage Up next turn for every 3 Value (max 6)
- Raise minimum Speed by 1 next turn for every 4 Value (max 2)
- Gain 1 Clash Power Up next turn for every 5 Value (max 2)

wild_hunt.name: Wild Hunt
wild_hunt.description:
- In the same turn this unit gained Wild Hunt for the first time, always have 1 remaining HP; "revive" (heal 50% HP and reset SP to 0) this unit at Turn End.
- If this unit is killed by an attack, gain 1 E.G.O resource for the least-owned E.G.O resource
- If this unit is killed by an attack, inflict 3 Sinking against the last attacker
- Dies at the end of the same turn this unit was revived in

dullahan.name: Dullahan
dullahan.description:
- Max Value: 3
- Gain 3 Offense Level
- Lose 3 Defense Level
- Raises Min & Max Speed values by 1
- Turn End: Gain 1 Dullahan next turn (At -25 SP or less, however, completely lose Dullahan)
- Turn End: If this unit has Dullahan, lose (15 - (Coffin/2)) SP. (min 10)

hardblood.name: Hardblood
hardblood.description:
- Max Stack: 10
- Stage 1 Hardblood
- At 10+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood II.
- At 20+ Hardblood, converts to Hardblood III.
- Reverts to the previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- Hardblood does not drop below 1.
- Raise Min & Max Speed values by 1 for every 10 Hardblood
- At Hardblood II, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack (1 / 5 Stack)
- At Hardblood III, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up based on the Stack (1 / 5 Stack)

shimmering【bloodfiend】.name: Shimmering [BloodFiend]
shimmering【bloodfiend】.description:
- Max Stack: 50
- As long as this effect exists, all Bleed damage taken by the Shield HP is converted to Bloodfeast.
- Gain Shield HP equal to the Stack at the moment of its application
- Expires at Turn End

blooming_thorn.name: Blooming Thorn
blooming_thorn.description:
- Max Value: 10
- Stage 1 Blooming Thorn
- Gain 1 Defense Level for every 2 Stack (max 5)
- When hit, inflict 1 Bleed against the attacker and lose 1 Stack
- [The Princess of La Manchaland Rodion Only]
· At max Stack, convert to the next Stage of this effect.
· (10+ Stack: Blooming Thorn II)
· (20+ Stack: Blooming Thorn III)
· Inflict +(Stage - 1) more Bleed and Rupture Potency using this unit's Base Attack Skill Coin effects.
· Reverts to previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.

festive_fever.name: Festive Fever
festive_fever.description:
- Max Value: 10
Expires at Turn End
- Against targets that have Bleed: deal +1.5% more damage for every Stack
- Skills that consume or gain Bloodfeast deal +3% more damage for every Stack instead

bloodied_hand.name: Bloodied Hand
bloodied_hand.description:
- Max Value: 10
- Stage 1 Bloodied Hand
- At 10+ Bloodied Hand, converts to Bloodied Hand II.
- At 20+ Bloodied Hand, converts to Bloodied Hand III.
- Reverts to previous Stage when the Stack drops below the requirements.
- At Bloodied Hand II, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack (1/10 Stack)
- At Bloodied Hand III, gain 1 Offense Level Up based on the Stack (1/10 Stack), and additionally inflict 1 Rupture and 1 Bleed On Hit with Base Skills

ailing_heart.name: Ailing Heart
ailing_heart.description:
- Max Value: 10
- Turn End: gain 1 Stack
- Turn Start: gain 1 Defense Level Up for every 3 Stack
- At 50%- HP, gain 1 Defense Level for every 3 Stack
- At 40%- HP, On Hit with Base Skills, heal (Stack x 5)% of damage dealt On Hit as HP (min 1; rounded down; heal up to 30 HP per Skill)

nebulizer_β.name: Nebulizer β
nebulizer_β.description:
- Max Stack: 5
- This effect persists throughout the Encounter
- When activating Pride A-Reson.: on Combat Start, apply 3 Poise and +3 Poise Count on self and (Stack) allies (prioritizes allies that gain or use Poise or Poise Count; among them, prioritize allies with the least Poise Potency)

nebulizer_α.name: Nebulizer α
nebulizer_α.description:
- Max Stack: 5
- This effect persists throughout the Encounter
- Combat Start: on all allies, including this unit, apply 1 Poise Potency and +1 Poise Count

deep_inhale.name: Deep Inhale
deep_inhale.description:
- Max Stack: 20
- On Crit: at 20+ Poise Potency and 5+ Poise Count, consume (Poise Potency on self / 5) Poise Potency to deal +(Poise Potency consumed x 4)% more Damage on Critical Hit and lose 1 Stack

strider【mao】.name: Strider [Mao]
strider【mao】.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- Turn End: gain 5 Haste next turn
- Reduced by 1 at Turn End

strider【wu】.name: Strider [Wu]
strider【wu】.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- Turn End: gain 2 Haste and (Stack x 2) Aggro next turn
- Before Attack: inflict (Stack) Tremor Potency against the main target (max 6 per turn)
- Lose 1 Stack at Turn End

linebreaker.name: Linebreaker
linebreaker.description:
- Max Stack: 5
- Turn Start: gain (Stack x 10) Shield for this turn
- At max Stack, gain 2 Final Power
- When hit: if this unit took 100+ damage from a single Skill, gain Protection after Skill End (2 times per turn; includes damage against Shield HP; does not count damage from Keywords)

commanding_cry.name: Commanding Cry
commanding_cry.description:
- Gain 1 Clash Power and 2 Defense Level
- Expires at Turn End

cumulus_wall.name: Cumulus Wall
cumulus_wall.description:
Max Stack: 1
Defense Skill Final Power +1
This effect expires at Turn End or Attack End of the following: 'Rules of the Backstreets'

battle_ready.name: Battle Ready
battle_ready.description:
Max Value: 1
Bleed Potency and Count inflicted using this unit's Skill or Coin effects: +1
Gain 1 Slash Power Up and 3 Slash DMG Up for the duration of this Encounter

dark_cloud_blade.name: Dark Cloud Blade
dark_cloud_blade.description:
Max Stack: 1
Gain 1 Slash Power
Inflict 1 Bleed On Hit with Slash Skills

serpent_arm.name: Serpent Arm
serpent_arm.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- Turn End: gain 3 Poise and +2 Poise count next turn
- On Base Attack Skill use, if target has Rupture, gain 5 Poise
- Turn End: lose 1 Stack

assist_[援].name: Assist [援]
assist_[援].description:
- Max Stack: 1
- If target has 5+ negative effects, Clash Power +1, deal +10% damage

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description:
- Loses this effect when this unit gains Savage Tigermark Round
- Min & Max Speed +2
- Base Attack Skills Lose (cumulative number of Tigermark Rounds & Savage Tigermark Rounds spent / 2) Clash Power (max 10); however, gain the following effects(cumulative):
· Cumulative Rounds spent: X
· 8+ Rounds spent: Gain 1 Protection for every 10% missing HP on self at Turn Start (max 5)
· 14+ Rounds spent: On Clash Lose, Unbreakable Coins of this unit's Base Attack Skills deal +(75 + missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 150%)
· 20+ Rounds spent: Deal +(HP percentage difference)% damage against targets with higher remaining HP percentage than this unit (max 50%; except E.G.O Skills)

scorch_propellant_ammo.name: Scorch Propellant Ammo
scorch_propellant_ammo.description:
- Unique Ammo
- Max Stack : 15
- Consumed when using certain Skills
- Counts as Ammo

fell_bullet.name: Fell Bullet
fell_bullet.description:
Max Stack: 1
+3% damage on Critical Hit for every Torn Memory (max 18%)
On Hit, inflict 1 Bleed (3 per turn)
On Kill, gain 3 Poise and +2 Poise Count (2 times per turn)
Expires at Turn End

deep_tears.name: Deep Tears
deep_tears.description:
- Unique Charge (Potency Fixed)
- Resource used by certain Skills for additional effects
- Max Stack: 20

piercing_sword.name: Piercing Sword
piercing_sword.description:
- Turn Start: gain 1 Offense Level Up for every Stack (max 5)
- Turn Start: -(Stack x 0.15) Aggro to this unit's Skill Slots on the Dashboard (max 0.75)
- Max Stack: 5
- Expires at Turn End

protecting_sword.name: Protecting Sword
protecting_sword.description:
- Turn Start: gain 1 Defense Level Up for every Stack (max 5)
- Turn Start: +(Stack x 3) Aggro to the leftmost Skill Slot on the Dashboard (max 15)
- Max Stack: 5
- Expires at Turn End

tear-sharpened.name: Tear-sharpened
tear-sharpened.description:
- Turn Start: gain 5 Deep Tears
· At 3 Stack, gain additional 5 Deep Tears
- Turn End: lose (Stack x 15) SP
- Base Attack Skills deal +(Stack x 10)% damage (max 30%)
- If this unit has Blessing, gain Clash Power Up by the effect's Stack at Turn Start
- If this unit has Despair, gain Pierce Power Up by the effect's Stack at Turn Start
- Max Stack: 3

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.description:
- Turn Start: gain 1 Protecting Sword for every 8 SP (max 5)
- When Clash ends, inflict 2 Sinking (once per turn)
- When hit, inflict 2 Sinking on the attacker (once per turn)
- For every 20 SP, inflict +1 more Sinking Potency with above effects (max 2)
- Replace this unit's Base Skills with Plus Coin Skills

despair.name: Despair
despair.description:
- Turn Start: gain 1 Piercing Sword for every -8 SP (max 5)
- When Clash ends, inflict +1 Sinking Count (once per turn)
- On Hit with the first Coin of a Base Attack Skill, inflict +1 Sinking Count (once per turn)
- For every -20 SP, inflict +1 more Sinking Count with above effects (max 2)
- Replace this unit's Base Skills with Minus Coin Skills

love/hate.name: Love-Hate
love/hate.description:
- Max Count: 20
- Unique Charge
- Resource used by certain Skills for additional effects. Its Count can go up to 20. Count lowers by 1 at the end of each turn.
(Interacts the same way as normal Charge does to effects that raise or reduce Charge Potency/Count)

magical_girl's_chant.name: Magical Girl's Chant
magical_girl's_chant.description:
- Max Stack: 2
- When this unit gains this effect, gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up
- This unit's Attack Skills that gain or consume Charge Count gain Final Power +1 and deal +10% damage
- Reduced by 1 at Turn End

here_comes_magical_girl!.name: Here Comes Magical Girl!
here_comes_magical_girl!.description:
- For this turn, this unit uses Plus Coin Attack Skills
- Base Attack Skills deal +3% damage for every Love/Hate on self (max 15%)

magical_arcana.name: Magical Arcana
magical_arcana.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- Base Attack Skills deal +(Stack x 5)% damage
- Turn End: At 3 Stack and with -25 or higher SP, change SP to -25

violent_collections.name: Violent Collections
violent_collections.description:
- When this unit has Haste, gain +1 more Tremor Count from its Base Skills
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +(Speed difference x 3)% damage (max 15%)

accumulated_past.name: Accumulated Past
accumulated_past.description:
- Max Stack: 12
- Turn Start: gain 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Offense Level Up for every 3 Stack

leash-holder_of_all_heishou.name: Leash Holder of All Heishou
leash-holder_of_all_heishou.description:
- Max Stack: 11
- Gain the following effects based on Stack:
· For every 1 Stack, gain 1 Max Speed (max 5) and deal 1% more damage with Skills
· For every 2 Stack, gain 1 Min Speed (max 2) and 1 Defense Level Up (max 5)
· For every 3 Stack, gain 1 Offense Level Up (max 3)
· At 5+ Stack, gain 1 Damage Up and apply 1 Offense Level Up to all Heishou Pack Identities

life_from_death_[死中求活].name: Life from Death [死中求活]
life_from_death_[死中求活].description:
- Max Stack: 5
- Turn Start: activate the following
· Gain 1 Offense Level Up for every 1 Stack (max 5)
· Gain 1 Damage Up for every 2 Stack (max 2)
· Gain 1 Attack Power Up at 3+ Stack

heishou_bolus_contamination_[黑獸丸染].name: Heishou Bolus Contamination [黑獸丸染]
heishou_bolus_contamination_[黑獸丸染].description:
- Max Stack: 11
- Empowers The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu based on which Heishou he activated combo with
- The Heishou Bolus Contamination effects can stack with each other:
· Heishou - Mao Adept Faust: take -5% damage from Skills
· Heishou - Mao Ryōshū: if this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +5% damage
· Heishou - Mao Outis: inflict +1 Rupture Count On Hit with Unopposed Attacks (once per turn)
· Heishou - Si Rodion: inflict 1 Rupture On Critical Hit (3 times per turn)
· Heishou - Si Gregor: Gain +1 Poise Count when dealing Rupture damage (once per turn)
· Heishou - Wu Adept Yi Sang: trigger Tremor Burst once on Final Coin (once per turn)
· Heishou - You Adept Heathcliff: deal 5% of Gluttony damage dealt as Wrath damage
· Heishou - You Sinclair: inflict 1 Burn when inflicting Rupture (3 times per turn)
· Heishou - Wei Don Quixote: inflict 1 Sinking when inflicting Rupture (3 times per turn)

tarnished_blood.name: Tarnished Blood
tarnished_blood.description:
Max Stack: 5
- Turn End: take 20% HP damage per Stack (cannot be Staggered by this effect)
- Gain 1 Stack at Turn End
- Expires upon death or Retreat

unrelenting_storm.name: Unrelenting Storm
unrelenting_storm.description:
- Number of times this unit activated combo with The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu Identity
- Max Stack: 2
- Turn Start: gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up for every Stack

flower-burying_pin_[埋花針].name: Flower Burying Pin [埋花針]
flower-burying_pin_[埋花針].description:
Max Stack: 20

- Effects remain active even if the corresponding ally is defeated
Haute Couture::Boutique du Rouge Ishmael
- If Ishmael is in "Full Makeover" state, Sinclair's max HP +10%; Sinclair's heals 5% max HP On Base Attack Hit (rounded up, 5 times per turn)
Haute Couture::Le Rouge King of Needleworks Heathcliff
- On Hit using the "La Demande" Skill's Coins, gain +1 Pulsation Count and heal 5% HP

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description:
- Max Stack: 30
- Can gain up to 20 Stacks per turn
Turn Start: If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger (once per Encounter; excluding forced Staggers)

thundercrack.name: Thundercrack
thundercrack.description:
- Max Stack: 3
- For every Stack:
· Coin Power +1
· Base Skills deal +15% damage against enemies
- If Wild Hunt Heathcliff has been defeated or Retreated, expires

learning_by_example.name: Learning by Example
learning_by_example.description:
Max Stack: 30
Gain Stacks based on the following conditions:
- On Clash Win, gain 2 Stacks; On Hit using Base Attack Skills, gain 1 Stack; At Attack End, if the enemy was defeated, gain 3 Stacks
- On Clash Win using Base Attack Skills by other allies, gain 2 Stacks
· On Clash Win using Base Attack Skills by other allies in the same faction as this unit, gain 4 Stacks instead
Gain the following effects cumulatively based on Stacks:
- Base Attack Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack (max 30%)
- 10+: Base Attack Skills Clash Power +1
- 20+: Base Attack Skills Coin Power +1

the_one_beyond_despair.name: The One Beyond Despair
the_one_beyond_despair.description:
- Turn Start: Gain 2 Protection and 1 Attack Power Up
- On Defense Skill Use, gain 3 Defense Power Up (once per turn)
- On Clash Win, heal 5 SP (2 times per turn)
· At max SP, remove 1 removable negative effect applied to self
- At Base Skill End, deal Pride damage equal to 10% of damage the said Skill dealt to each enemy
- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, it does not take damage for the turn (once per Encounter)
· After the above effect activates, heal all HP next turn; then, deal +10% damage for every Protection on self until Combat End (max 80%)
